title: Flick (YC F25) Is Hiring Front End Engineer to Build Figma for AI Filmmaking
summary: Flick is a Y Combinator F25 startup building 'Figma for AI Filmmaking' - a collaborative web-based tool for AI-powered video creation. They are actively hiring a Senior Front End Engineer to help build this creative platform.
problem_solved: Democratizes AI filmmaking by providing collaborative tools that make AI-powered video creation as accessible as traditional design tools like Figma.
why_valuable: As the creator economy and AI video generation market rapidly expands, tools that simplify and democratize AI-powered content creation have significant market potential and societal impact.
